text:
Aisha: Heads up — qint8 reranker bring-up on dedupe/recall looks off in internal benchmarks. seeing ~3-5% rerank MRR drop vs int8 baseline.
Ben: on which workload? can you paste the eval slice?
Aisha: short-rerank test + long-tail anchors. gist: https://redwood-infer.link/q8b-rerank-compare (private)
Claire: ouch. any sign it's tokenization/quantization mismatch or the promptset?
Aisha: quick triage: logits look noisier on tail examples, many near-equal top-3 scores. embeddings for anchors are fine.
Diego: could be subtle float underflow from the per-channel quant settings. I can run a qint8-repro with larger calibration set.
Aisha: please. also need curation ops to refresh microgolden for the rerank slices — some duplicates leaked into the holdout making variance worse.
Claire: labeler-bot: can you report current golden freshness and dedupe backlog for the rerank cohort?
labeler-bot: Golden freshness: 18 days. Dedupe backlog: 420 items. Current annotator capacity: 6 FTE-equivalent. ETA to clear backlog at current pace: ~7d.
Ben: timeline-wise, we need a quick canary. propose: 1) run Diego's qint8-repro on small calibration + add stability seeds, 2) refresh ~200 microgolden items from the rerank tail (prefer least-duplicate), 3) run jittered eval.
Aisha: agreed. also request sampling tweak — avoid prefix overlap. current sampler command: 
```
python sample_cohort.py --cohort rerank_tail --size 500 --dedupe-window 512 --seed 42
```
Change seed rotation and reduce dedupe-window to 256 for microgolden to surface near-dupes for relabel.
Claire: will coordinate labeler ops, but capacity needs topping up or we risk wait. @Ben can we allocate 2 FTE from adjacent campaigns for 4 days?
Ben: yes, we can borrow 2 for 3 days starting tomorrow. will email ops and cc Claire.
Diego: i'll post qint8-repro results in this thread by EOD:6132470200 (approx).
Aisha: if Diego's repro still shows MRR drop after microgolden refresh, fallback plan: route rerank calls to int8 for tiered flow and run extended quant calibration (per-layer).
Ben: +1 on fallback. also add a quick smoke harness that fails CI if rerank MRR drops >2% on the microgolden set.
Claire: noted. i'll update the handoff checklist and kick off labeler surge. will attach updated sampler and golden list here once available. :white_check_mark:
Aisha: thanks — tagging followups: @Diego send repro logs, @Claire attach refreshed golden list, @Ben confirm FTE shift.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: rerank-qint8-canary -> cluster-4 at 2026-03-15T20:40:00Z (will be gated on microgolden smoke result).
Diego: uploaded repro artifacts: s3://redwood-dev/qint8-repro/6132469870/report.html — initial run shows calibration instability on layer 9. will try per-layer quant table next.
Aisha: good progress. keeping thread open for results. trying to keep the rollback window small.
Claire: golden list (200 items) uploaded to /golden/rerank/micro200/6132469870.csv — starting labeling now, ETA 48h with surge.
Ben: ops confirmed 2 FTE shift tomorrow AM. monitoring.
Aisha: perf note — even if global MRR ok, watch tail recall and rerank tie-breaking. those user-facing regressions are the killer.
Diego: running per-layer quant and seed-ensemble next, will post by EOD.
Aisha: thanks everyone. we should reconvene if smoke fails. :eyes:
